  std::string text

  std::string arguments

  Role role
  std::vector<Part> parts

  std::string description

struct FrameWriter
  virtual void write_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct DispatchError : std::runtime_error

  virtual std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame)
struct ServiceError : std::runtime_error
  std::string code, message
inline constexpr std::string_view kEndpointContract
struct DescribedService
  std::string contract
  bool ready
  std::string why
std::string describe_endpoint(std::string_view frame, const std::string& program, const std::string& version, const Services& . . . services)
struct Chat
  virtual Admission start(const Request& request)
  virtual DeltaPage observe(const std::string& operation, const std::int64_t& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_deltas, const std::int64_t& max_bytes, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual Cancellation cancel(const std::string& operation)
template<class Transport>struct ChatClient : Chat
  Transport& transport_
  Admission start(const Request& request) override
  DeltaPage observe(const std::string& operation, const std::int64_t& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_deltas, const std::int64_t& max_bytes, const std::int64_t& wait_ms) override
  Cancellation cancel(const std::string& operation) override
struct ChatService
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kWireName
  inline static constexpr std::string_view kCapability
struct ChatDispatcher : FrameWriter, FrameExchanger
  Chat& handler
  DescribedService describe_service() const
  void write_frame(std::string_view frame) override
  std::string exchange_frame(std::string_view frame) override
struct ChatV2
  virtual AdmissionV2 start(const RequestV2& request)
  virtual DeltaPage observe(const std::string& operation, const std::int64_t& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_deltas, const std::int64_t& max_bytes, const std::int64_t& wait_ms)
  virtual Cancellation cancel(const std::string& operation)

struct Operator
  virtual HostList hosts()
  virtual HostChange add_host(const std::string& expected_revision, const HostEntry& host)
  virtual HostChange remove_host(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name)
  virtual KeyList keys()
  virtual KeyIssued issue_key(const std::string& program, const std::string& credential)
  virtual KeyRevoked revoke_key(const std::string& program)
  virtual AuditPage audit(const std::int64_t& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_entries)
  virtual GatewayState gateway()
  virtual GatewayChange set_gateway(const std::string& expected_revision, const bool& open, const std::string& address)
template<class Transport>struct OperatorClient : Operator
  Transport& transport_
  HostList hosts() override
  HostChange add_host(const std::string& expected_revision, const HostEntry& host) override
  HostChange remove_host(const std::string& expected_revision, const std::string& name) override
  KeyList keys() override
  KeyIssued issue_key(const std::string& program, const std::string& credential) override
  KeyRevoked revoke_key(const std::string& program) override
  AuditPage audit(const std::int64_t& cursor, const std::int64_t& max_entries) override
  GatewayState gateway() override
  GatewayChange set_gateway(const std::string& expected_revision, const bool& open, const std::string& address) override
